# httpwg structured-field-tests, vendored

The test corpus for HTTP Structured Fields, copied unmodified from https://github.com/httpwg/structured-field-tests at commit `00462dd7938b43bf596cb2af6a373d9c928a6cbe` (2026-09-16). It is licensed under the BSD-3-Clause terms in `LICENSE.md` beside this file, which is kept as the license requires.

Every port runs it against its own RFC 8941 parser (`this.i` @7fexwu3s). It is third-party data, not a fiki vector: nothing here is generated by fiki, and it carries no fiki format number. The corpus also covers RFC 9651, which added Dates and Display Strings; RFC 9421 normatively references RFC 8941, so fiki's parsers refuse those two types, and each port's runner expects that refusal for `date.json`, `display-string.json`, and any other case whose expected value uses them.

To move to a newer commit, re-copy every file listed here from that commit, update the commit above, and expect each port's corpus test to say what changed.
